passages.title: Procedure Text: Personal Budgeting
passages.text: A school finance club shared a simple budgeting guide. First, record your weekly allowance. Second, list essential expenses such as transport and meals. Third, decide on a realistic amount to save. Only then consider optional purchases. Check whether the total plan exceeds your allowance. If it does, revise optional spending before reducing essential costs. At the end of the week, compare your plan with your actual expenses. The guide advises students to review their choices rather than blame themselves for an imperfect first attempt.
